evals.prompt: Review this US FTO report, focusing on applicability of selected documents and reliability of facts/claim analysis. Exclude the screening process.
evals.expected_output: Review search, selected-document results, analysis and compliance. Verify identity/applicability, relevance and citation relationships. Keep factual basis and original-text comparison as separate analytical tracks. Use formal English without process scores or technical fields in the body.

evals.prompt: Review a novelty report that combines passages from two patents to conclude that a claim lacks novelty.
evals.expected_output: Use the novelty scenario. Explain that novelty generally requires complete disclosure in one document and verify the full-text passages carrying the key disclosure.

evals.prompt: The report uses selected patent A’s abstract to support claim coverage. Review this analysis.
evals.expected_output: Use the official fetch_patent tool to verify the selected document’s original text. Distinguish abstract descriptions from claim limitations and provide supported written findings with impact. Do not investigate how it was selected.

evals.prompt: Review this EoU report. It lists patent claims but provides no accused-product manual or physical evidence.
evals.expected_output: Separate patent-side and product-side evidence. Do not infer product facts from patent MCP data. Mark product conclusions unverifiable or request evidence.

evals.prompt: The report states a patent was definitely in force in Germany on June 1, 2024, but the official MCP returns only a simple status without complete events for that date.
evals.expected_output: Do not expand simple status into a date-specific conclusion. Record tool limitations and not_verifiable; do not turn missing fields into negatives or zeroes.

evals.prompt: Here is our new product proposal. Perform a complete FTO search from scratch and generate a Word report.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger this review workflow: the user requests FTO execution from scratch and has no report-review objective.

evals.prompt: Draft invention patent claims from this technical disclosure.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger patent-search-report-reviewer.

evals.prompt: Check whether this report has problems.
evals.expected_output: Trigger only if context or attachments identify a patent report. Otherwise clarify the report type rather than overgeneralizing the trigger.

evals.prompt: Review the screening-records material in fixtures.json, considering only final selected results, not the screening process. Historical author dispositions are attached.
evals.expected_output: Review only final candidate C’s applicability, relevance and citations. Do not score R2 reasons, inconsistent dispositions or unresolved R4 records; do not request screening logs. State scope once and do not mark out-of-scope matters unverifiable or lower the overall conclusion.

evals.prompt: Review final-list-only in fixtures.json. The author has not supplied screening records.
evals.expected_output: Verify both final documents’ identities, dates and citation mapping from supplied facts; the reviewed results are acceptable. Exclusion reasons/full candidate pools are unnecessary. Do not create unverifiable-exclusion metrics, evidence demands or conditional acceptance because process records are absent.

evals.prompt: Review analysis-omitted-limitation in fixtures.json, evaluating only the supplied literal comparison.
evals.expected_output: Verify product facts and original versions. A1 meets this test’s scope; A2 does not: replacing 30–40 newtons with any clamping force cannot support satisfaction of every element. This alone does not establish non-infringement. Do not call CC to vote again.

evals.prompt: Review eou-missing-product-fact in fixtures.json: the report infers that the product lacks a temperature sensor because the manual does not mention one.
evals.expected_output: Product facts under A1 are unverifiable; A2 fails because non-disclosure does not establish absence. Request physical/design/test evidence rather than infer product facts from patent MCP or CC.

evals.prompt: Review supported-analysis in fixtures.json: a limited literal comparison supported by original text and product measurements. Do not assume it is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Under the confirmed versions and measurement conditions, both A1/A2 are met. Conclude only that the reviewed limitation is supported, not whole-patent infringement or complete FTO. Do not penalize absence of re-screening.

evals.prompt: Use novelty-selected-late-document to review selected documents and analysis results in a patentability report and provide written findings.
evals.expected_output: D2 was published after the critical date. Under this test’s explicitly adopted public-prior-art rule, it cannot support the assigned earlier-publication role. Recommend correcting citations and conclusions using dates, report locations and impact. Do not review why D2 was selected or infer a screening-process error.

evals.prompt: Use novelty-combination-writing to review novelty and inventive-step analysis in formal, readable English.
evals.expected_output: State directly that the negative novelty conclusion lacks support. Cite D1/D2 locations accurately, explain novelty and inventive step separately and recommend concrete revisions. Omit internal IDs, tool paths, status codes and colloquial disparagement. Do not invent dates, paragraphs or full-text conclusions or request screening materials.

evals.prompt: Review Appendix A’s synonym expansion and concept-query logic and provide structured IPR findings.
evals.expected_output: Identify unconstrained OR splitting a compound concept and broad-term drift; preserve nested phrases. Do not score quality directly as 0.9 or interpret relevance_score=0 as irrelevant. Explain restrictions and evidence for each term. The attached expansion receipt is historical; its presence does not automatically require new calls.

evals.prompt: Review whether Appendix B’s query logic supports the report’s technical objective.
evals.expected_output: Use A=true, C=false to show a branch bypassing C. Reconstruct and label the derivation; do not penalize a missing standalone chapter. Give a conceptual illustration only, without claiming database validation or measured missed-hit counts.

evals.prompt: Review only concept combinations in Appendix C. Do not assume a defect because it lacks a separate term table.
evals.expected_output: Accept the alternatives, preserve OR rather than replacing everything with AND, identify query-derived terms and reuse applicable supplied receipts. Limit conclusions to the reviewed logic.

evals.prompt: The candidate-expansion tool failed. Continue reviewing Appendix D and state limitations.
evals.expected_output: Mark expanded candidates pending verification, but still identify mutually exclusive drives incorrectly joined with AND. Do not invent receipts, block the entire review or request screening logs.

evals.prompt: Review only this EoU conclusion, excluding search. Provide a quality overview, key issues and revision recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Review facts and source reasoning: unknown is not absent. Deliver the three requested sections; do not call synonym expansion, search or screening, or fail out-of-scope dimensions.

evals.prompt: There is no report or existing query. Generate synonyms and a complete search strategy for a new technology area.
evals.expected_output: This is a search-strategy creation task, not report review; do not take it over with this skill.

evals.prompt: The validator says is_valid=true. Can this rewrite be adopted directly?
evals.expected_output: Syntax validity alone is insufficient. fixed_field_violated=true and AUTHORITY changed US to CN: verify and restore the authorized boundary. result_count>0 does not excuse the violation. Deliver only the three review sections. These flags come from a supplied historical receipt; do not claim the current integrated service exposes that validator or fields.

evals.prompt: One tool says 1,316 patents and the search interface says 1,069. Does that prove the report is wrong?
evals.expected_output: Do not conclude error directly. Distinguish one returned record, 1,069 search hits and a 1,316 validator count; verify family consolidation and boundaries. Do not call the difference of 247 missed patents or invent a common counting basis. Explain supplied cross-source records without treating their fields as native search_patent structure.

evals.prompt: Fetch structured claims and description with fetch_patent; put fulltext in include and use replace_by_related=0.
evals.expected_output: Use format=json and omit include or restrict it to relations/media. Do not send fulltext or replace_by_related. The integrated service has no atomic claims/description tool; do not pass atomic-interface parameters. In markdown mode, read response.markdown only.

evals.prompt: The full-text tool is unavailable. Continue reviewing the report.
evals.expected_output: Continue terminology, Boolean logic and existing-source comparison while disclosing external verification gaps. Tool unavailability is not automatically a report defect.

evals.prompt: Available tools use different prefixes, but their purposes and schemas support search and full-text verification.
evals.expected_output: Use actual exposed full names and verify schemas. Do not construct prefixes; matching short names do not imply matching parameters or result fields.

evals.prompt: The report provides an executable Patsnap query. Use build_patent_boolean_query to validate and optimize its syntax.
evals.expected_output: Do not pass executable queries to the builder. Review logic and boundaries directly; if needed, execute the original query with a bounded, exclusively boolean search_patent call. Disclose the lack of an independent validator and do not invent is_valid.

evals.prompt: The report includes complete natural-language search intent and synonym review is in scope. Add supported candidate expressions.
evals.expected_output: When candidates are needed, pass complete intent to build_patent_boolean_query, derive candidates from reference_query and assess meanings. Do not automatically execute the new expression, modify the opaque handle or treat it as a term list.

evals.prompt: I only need to verify a cited patent’s date. Should fetch_patent receive metadata_only=true?
evals.expected_output: Do not send undeclared parameters. Reuse actual receipts or search narrowly by known publication number. If fetching full text is necessary, do not claim all returned text was reviewed.

evals.prompt: The tool list has bulk_filter and build_claim_chart but no atomic claims tool. Call them as part of the report review anyway.
evals.expected_output: Obtain original text via fetch_patent; do not invent claims. Available screening/comparison tools do not justify expanding review scope. Review strategy and source text by issue without repeating screening or creating new CC.

evals.prompt: The environment already provides the required search and full-text tools. Review the report.
evals.expected_output: Use actual tools according to the issues. Do not require repeated connector configuration; retain review scope and three-part output.

evals.prompt: Full-text retrieval failed, but the user supplied the report text and the product website is readable. Continue reviewing.
evals.expected_output: Continue internal checks, verify product facts where needed and record sources/dates. Product evidence cannot replace missing patent claims; mark affected assertions pending verification.

evals.prompt: Review the attached report and quotations, focusing on evidence versions and consistent conclusions.
evals.expected_output: Identify one version-miscitation root cause affecting overview, comparison and conclusion; combine the issue and list all three locations. Distinguish unknown product structure from absence, preserve correct facts and do not request screening logs. Specify needed version and product evidence.

evals.prompt: Verify only the three attached bibliographic facts. Do not review anything else.
evals.expected_output: If all three facts match, issue a limited pass. Other content remains unreviewed; do not extend acceptance to the whole report/claims or invent out-of-scope defects to fill a quota.

fixture.report: Title: Test Valve; publication number: Example A; publication date: 2020-01-02.
fixture.comparison_material: Title: Test Valve; publication number: Example A; publication date: 2020-01-02.

evals.prompt: Search active Chinese safety-socket patents, focusing on cross-circuit wiring and base structures. First prepare a screening report, then check whether its similarity judgments have original-text support.
evals.expected_output: Recognize a generate-then-review compound request. This review workflow does not search from scratch. Before a report exists, record review as pending with required report/query/original materials; do not fabricate a report or initiate generation to trigger tools. Once the actual draft is readable, verify similarity assertions within the defined review scope.

evals.prompt: Complete a novelty report for my technical solution, then review whether cited originals support the conclusions.
evals.expected_output: Report generation is outside this review workflow. With no solution/report currently available, explain needed review materials and remain pending rather than substitute generic retrieval. Once the actual report is readable, verify citation support without asking again for material already available.

evals.prompt: Search invalidity evidence for a specified Chinese patent using publications before August 7, 1997, then review the report’s dates and quoted passages.
evals.expected_output: Fresh invalidity retrieval is outside this review workflow. If target patent/report are missing, identify required inputs without creating a search report. Once a reviewable report exists, check date boundaries, evidence eligibility and quotations for invalidity purposes. A date instruction alone does not establish completed review.

evals.prompt: Only review whether citations in this existing FTO report support its conclusions; do not redo FTO.
evals.expected_output: Read the actual report and conduct the bounded citation-support review. If the report is not supplied in this case, request it rather than assume it was read. Reuse evidence and target original-text checks as needed, without rerunning full FTO or reviewing the Screening process.
